name: The Succubus Won't Fuck Me
source:
One long week of hard work and the weekend is still far away.

At least sleeping can't give you any more stress...

But what is this weight on your chest? A succubus!?

[From [url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/the-succubus-wont-fck-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
辛苦工作了一周，距离周末还很远。

至少睡觉不会给你带来更多的压力……

但你胸口的重量是多少？魅魔！？

[来自[url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/the-succubus-wont-fck-me]itch.io[/url]]
